Bounded external extension of a waiting runner; never pauses its simulator.

Python 3.12 Popen._wait reaps a finished child before checking timeout. Suspend
only the waiting Python parent, then resume it once ngspice exits. The original
watchdog terminates ngspice if this supervisor's replacement deadline expires.
